Yes, the protestor may be prosecuted. Dumping the trash was symbolic speech, but the littering ordinance is a content-neutral rule that serves the city’s substantial interest in keeping parks clean and is not aimed at his message, so enforcement is valid under United States v. O’Brien and Clark v. Community for Creative Non-Violence. Treating the dumping as non-speech, or treating symbolic speech as immune from regulation, is not the governing rule.

CONFIDENCE: 92
